title: Conforti–Cornuéjols replication conjecture
statement: Conforti–Cornuéjols replication conjecture · 1993. It says every clutter with the packing property has the max-flow min-cut property (attribution and status).

counterexample.description: Find a finite clutter whose every minor packs but which fails MFMC for an integral weight. Exact LP/ILP certificates verify all minors.
